segments.name: Development of gene editing-based therapies
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical company developing CRISPR gene editing-based therapies for patients with severe diseases such as hereditary angioedema and ATTR amyloidosis.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified one operating and reportable segment: the development of gene editing-based therapies.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue primarily through collaboration arrangements with third parties, such as Regeneron, which pay upfront payments, milestones, royalties and cost-sharing.
revenueModel.evidence: The operating segment's revenue is primarily generated through collaboration arrangements with third parties.
